claim: The ten even theta sectors admit a full scalar modular closure through the Igusa form chi10, but this symmetric scalar forgets the oriented seam and is not a factor of the degree-two Leech theta series.
status: standard Igusa construction plus exact separating-order and weight/divisor obstruction

chi5.definition: product of the ten even theta constants

chi10.definition: chi5 squared, equivalently a normalized product of the ten squared even theta constants

obstruction.reason: A chi10 multiple vanishes on the separating divisor, while the Leech theta series factorizes there to a generically nonzero product.

interpretation: Full modular scalar closure of the seam orbit is mathematically available.
The scalar product records the separating divisor with multiplicity two but erases which affine transition supplied it.
The bosonic Leech pair theta series does not automatically contain this spin-structure seam.
Retaining seam orientation requires marked subgroup data, a vector-valued form, a defect category, or additional fermionic/Pfaffian structure.
